steps.label: 2279-own-paper1093-modify-link
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1093')throw Error('Own QA paper only');const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].filter(e=>{const u=new URL(e.getAttribute('href'),location.origin);return u.pathname==='/paper/modify.donga'&&u.searchParams.get('paperId')==='1093';});if(links.length!==1||links[0].classList.contains('disabled'))throw Error('Expected own modify action');const href=links[0].getAttribute('href');links[0].click();return {href};})()
